mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders(order_no, user_id, total_amount, status) VALUES(#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{totalAmount}, #{status})
INSERT INTO order_item(order_id, book_id, book_title, price, quantity) VALUES(#{orderId}, #{bookId}, #{bookTitle}, #{price}, #{quantity})
mapper.select: SELECT o.*, u.id AS u_id, u.username, u.real_name FROM orders o JOIN user u ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY o.create_time DESC

SELECT o.*, u.id AS u_id, u.username, u.real_name FROM orders o JOIN user u ON o.user_id = u.id
AND o.status = #{status}
AND (o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
